comments.content: Changing `content` from `&'static str` to `String` forces every embedded guide (`SHARED`, `LANGUAGE_GUIDES`, layer guides) to be allocated on each `owned_set`/`bundle_set` call, even though only the rendered OCR rule file is dynamic. `Cow<'static, str>` would keep the static guides allocation-free while still allowing the rendered rule file to own its content.

Consider returning early after pushing the project-rule problem, or skipping the rule-file comparison when the project rules could not be read.
